patterns.note: A dominant, dark, full-width background is used to create a canvas for vibrant, generated text art examples.
Content is organized into distinct, full-width sections that use internal max-width containers to center text and structured elements like grids and pricing tables.
Extensive use of responsive image grids showcases the product's output, with categorized tags beneath each image for filtering and context.
Large, bold sans-serif typography is used for main headings to establish hierarchy and draw attention to key sections like 'AI Font Generator' and '114+ AI Font Styles'.
Lighter weight, high-contrast sans-serif fonts are used for body text and descriptions, ensuring readability against the dark background.
A deep, dark navy/purple serves as the primary background color, providing a sophisticated and tech-oriented base.
Vibrant gradient accents, predominantly purples and blues, are applied to call-to-action buttons and interactive elements, making them pop against the dark interface.
The hero section immediately presents an interactive generator interface with input fields and style selection, allowing for immediate product engagement.
A clear, three-step 'How to Generate' section simplifies the user journey and sets expectations for interaction with the tool.
Dedicated sections for 'Community Creations' and 'Pricing' reinforce social proof and convert interest into paid usage.

technique_notes: To achieve the dark, immersive background, use a dark base color (e.g., #0B0A12) with subtle radial gradients of slightly lighter, complementary dark hues to add depth without brightness.

For interactive elements like buttons and highlights, apply a linear gradient using two high-contrast, saturated colors (e.g., #8A2BE2 to #FF69B4) set at an angle to create a dynamic and appealing visual effect.

Implement a responsive grid display for image galleries, where each grid item contains an image, a descriptive title, and a series of interactive, pill-shaped tags for categorization. These tags can trigger client-side filtering.
